title: @andrea9293/mcp-documentation-server Web UI binds to all interfaces without authentication (CVE-2026-54504)
summary: @andrea9293/mcp-documentation-server (npm) 1.13.0: the Web UI/API that starts automatically on port 3080 binds to all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) instead of localhost-only, and its document-management API endpoints require no authentication — any network-adjacent attacker can read, modify, or delete the server's documents. Fixed in 1.13.1.
